answer: Give each seat a rate-limiting nullifier. Joining locks a stake into a membership tree; every answer or vote carries a zk proof of membership plus a share of a line through the seat's secret key, keyed to the epoch. One signal per epoch reveals nothing, but a second signal from the same seat hands anyone two points on that line, so the first raven to spot them recovers the key and sweeps the stake. A farm can't stretch one paid seat into an orchard of fake voices; every voice past that ridge needs its own fresh stake.
